name: Panama City
tagline: Skyscrapers, a colonial old town and the canal
summary: Panama City mixes a glassy skyline with Casco Viejo's restored colonial streets. Watch giant ships pass the Panama Canal locks at Miraflores, walk the Amador Causeway and head out to the San Blas islands.
seasonNote: Dry season January to April. Rains most afternoons from May.
cashTip: Panama uses US dollars. Cards work widely in the city; carry small bills for taxis and islands.
foodTip: Ceviche at the fish market, sancocho and Geisha coffee.
